symptom: Save & connect wrote the server and started sign-in, then the settings watcher saw that same write and reconnected every gateway backend, which cancelled the pending sign-in.
rule: A settings-watcher reload keeps an unchanged gateway backend set; saves and credential changes still reconnect, and a failed gateway still retries. Hold the second, unforced reload and assert no reconnect (principles 13 and 14).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/__tests__/engine-gateway-catalog.test.ts -t 'pending sign-in'
